import z3

n = 19
colors = 3
min_edges = 29
girth = 7  # no cycles of length < 7

# Create edge variables
edge_vars = {}
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        edge_vars[(i,j)] = z3.Bool(f"e_{i}_{j}")

# Create color variables (integer 0..2)
color_vars = [z3.Int(f"c_{i}") for i in range(n)]

s = z3.Solver()

# Color bounds
for i in range(n):
    s.add(color_vars[i] >= 0, color_vars[i] < colors)

# If edge, then colors differ
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        s.add(z3.Implies(edge_vars[(i,j)], color_vars[i] != color_vars[j]))

# At least min_edges
s.add(z3.Sum([z3.If(edge_vars[(i,j)], 1, 0) for (i,j) in edge_vars]) >= min_edges)

# Check: how many constraints?
print(f"Number of edge vars: {len(edge_vars)}")
print(f"Number of constraints so far: {len(s.assertions())}")

# Try to solve without cycle constraints first
result = s.check()
print(f"Result without cycle constraints: {result}")
if result == z3.sat:
    model = s.model()
    edges = [(i,j) for (i,j), v in edge_vars.items() if z3.is_true(model.evaluate(v))]
    colors_assigned = [model.evaluate(color_vars[i]).as_long() for i in range(n)]
    print(f"Edges: {len(edges)}")
    print(f"Colors: {colors_assigned}")
else:
    print("Unsatisfiable even without cycle constraints?")
